newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 6.
newsitem.headline: ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 6.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).

Carlton & United Breweries Ltd increased its relevant interest in Ballarat Brewing Company Limited (The) on 04/02/1997, from 20,090,123 ordinary shares (74.14%) to 20,902,430 ordinary shares (77.14%).
Jetan Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Austin Group Limited on 31/01/1997, from 1,510,000 ordinary shares (5.53%) to 2,188,000 ordinary shares (8.01%).

Malaysia Mining Corporation Bhd became a substantial shareholder in Cityview Corporation Limited on 31/12/1996 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 25,000,000 ordinary shares (45.59%).
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in John Fairfax Holdings Limited on 05/02/1997, from 57,968,141 ordinary shares (7.65%) to 65,844,548 ordinary shares (8.68%).
Packer & Co Ltd increased its relevant interest in Australian Oil & Gas Corporation Limited on 31/01/1997, from 3,254,785 ordinary shares (7.22%) to 3,749,358 ordinary shares (8.32%).
Stonedent Pty Ltd decreased its relevant interest in National Textiles Limited on 04/02/1997, from 636,458 ordinary shares (5.7%) to 591,458 ordinary shares (5.303%).
Australian Mutual Provident Society ceased to be a substantial shareholder in G.U.D. Holdings Limited on 03/02/1997.
Regent Pacific Corporate Advisory Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Heine Management Limited on 03/02/1997.

Permanent Trustee Company Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Qantas Airways Limited on 05/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 54,513,940 ordinary shares (5.04%).

FAI General Insurance Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Heine Management Limited on 03/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 3,735,300 ordinary shares (19.90%).
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd increased its relevant interest in Ridley Corporation Limited on 03/02/1997, from 14,672,464 ordinary shares (6.81%) to 17,476,672 ordinary shares (7.84%).
Banker's Trust Australia Ltd and associates* increased its relevant interest in Opsm Protector Limited on 03/02/1997, from 14,495,743 ordinary shares (10.11%) to 15,922,524 ordinary shares (11.11%).
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Telecasters Australia Limited on 03/02/1997, from 3,204,463 ordinary shares (15.92%) to 2,534,463 ordinary shares (12.59%).
Colonial Ltd increased its relevant interest in Western Metals Limited on 26/01/1997, from 6,858,336 ordinary shares (5.01%) to 17,510,283 ordinary shares (11.22%).
Australian Gold Fields NL became a substantial shareholder in Striker Resources NL on 31/01/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 20,252,000 ordinary shares (19.90%).
Camelot Resources NL increased its relevant interest in Mount Edon Gold Mines (Aust) Limited on 24/01/1997, from 10,652,506 ordinary shares (14.49%) to 12,143,616 ordinary shares (16.52%).

Coverley Pty Ltd, Daniel Martin Hill, & Hugh McLernon became a substantial shareholder in Noble Resources NL on 31/01/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 24,000,000 ordinary shares (18.01%).
Menzies Court Holdings Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Industrial Investment Corporation Limited on 02/12/1996.
